Implementation is complete and fully validated. Port 4000 is free with a clean data directory, so the broker will start the app fresh for your review.

## ✅ Bookmark Manager — built, tested, and ready for acceptance review

I implemented the complete approved scope via `speckit-implement`. All **63 tasks** are done and marked complete in `tasks.md`.

### How to review it
The app is registered for the review environment (`/work/.harness/app.json` → `npm start` on port 4000). Open **http://maker:4000**. It opens to the empty state (`data-harness-ready` fires after load); click **+ Save bookmark** to begin.

### What was built
One local Node process (Express) serving a React UI + JSON API on `0.0.0.0:4000`, with SQLite + filesystem storage — exactly the approved architecture.

| Story | Delivered |
|-------|-----------|
| **US1** Save | Auto-fetch title/description/favicon/preview; edit all fields at save & later; **duplicate opens the existing bookmark**; **delayed metadata never overwrites your input** |
| **US2** Browse | List shows title/description/tags/favicon; open in new tab; empty states |
| **US3** Organize | Markdown notes (rendered), tag suggestions, **one shared tag identity** (`News`=`news`), click-a-tag filter, read/unread, reversible archive, permanent delete |
| **US4** Search | Case-insensitive across title/description/note/url; `#tag`, `"phrases"`, `AND/OR/NOT` + `()`, `#tag word`=both, quoted operators literal; sort; clear errors |
| **US5** Bulk | Selected-set actions **and** "apply to all matching" the full view (scope + tag + include/exclude + search) across every page |
| **US6** Saved searches | Named, include/exclude tags, reopen/rename/delete |
| **US7** Snapshots & IA | Self-contained HTML snapshot, PDF kept as PDF, Internet Archive save (recoverable on failure) |
| **US8** Import/export | Netscape files preserving address, title, tags, **and date added** |
| **US9** Preferences | Default sort, items-per-page, font size — persisted |

### Verification
- **Unit tests: 27/27 pass** — search grammar, URL normalization, Netscape round-trip, and the **delayed-metadata safeguard** (a fetch resolving *after* a user edit leaves the user's value intact).
- **E2E: 23/23 pass** — one Playwright journey per story, including the multi-page "apply to all matching" guarantee and the safeguard.
- **Performance:** 500 bookmarks → list **7ms**, boolean search **6ms** (SC-008 met).
- I found and fixed one real bug during testing: bulk mark-read/unread used double-quoted SQL literals that SQLite read as column names (500 error); now parameterized, with the E2E strengthened so it can't regress silently.

### One honest caveat
The Internet Archive feature depends on archive.org being reachable from this environment; if it isn't during your review, the UI reports a recoverable error and leaves the bookmark intact (as specified) rather than faking success.

If anything in your review doesn't match the approved spec, tell me: per our SDD workflow, a divergence from the spec I fix by continuing implementation, while a genuine spec change routes back through the spec/plan gates first.
